title: Haikyu!!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Shoyo Hinata, a short junior-high player, is inspired by a televised match to take up volleyball. At Karasuno High he forms a setter-spiker partnership with his former rival Tobio Kageyama, and the team works to rebuild its reputation and reach the national tournament.
life_message: Holds up wholehearted effort shared with a team, where losses become lessons and rivals push each other to grow.

content.note: Sports collisions and occasional brief scuffles; Common Sense Media (anime) notes some blood (anime, to verify for manga).
Tense match stakes and defeats; no horror.
Locker-room shirtlessness and a few mild crush or ogling jokes per anime review (to verify for manga).
Anime review lists words up to one f-word; manga translation level not checked (to verify).
Some adult characters smoke and drink in the anime review (to verify for manga).
Players face self-doubt and pressure after losses; handled as growth.
Intense training and rivalry; nothing notable to copy beyond sport.
